what_happened: Hand-derived stab-value tables for four candidate fixtures (landed, +sink c, {a,b,d}, {a,b,c,d}) were confirmed by a 40-line CTL-style least-fixpoint script before any Lean was written; the refutation pairs (a,c) and (b,d) and every surviving shape came out exactly as computed by hand, so the plan can take the tables as settled rather than re-deriving them in Lean first.

The task budgets for a possible divergence between the plusTruthAt_iff_atomize (outer-stab) reading and the via_strata (inner-stab) reading on a three-state fixture. Both are biconditionals with the SAME direct value and the via_strata proofs use only stab_fp_iff_fresh, the atomModel inr clause and the clause lemmas -- fixture-independent -- so a divergence cannot occur on any fixture; the plan should not reserve a phase for investigating one.

On this toolchain 'deriving Fintype' on a 4-constructor enum fails (Finset.val/enumList coercion mismatch); a hand-built Fintype instance works and lets 'decide' settle the successor/predecessor tables. Int.le_induction is deprecated in favour of Int.leInduction. 'by omega' inside an anonymous-constructor tuple elaborates before its goal is known and fails; use lt_add_one / sub_one_lt or a named 'have'. All three fixed inline in the research skeleton.

Lean Challenge Statements pinning gotcha: a sorry-bodied 'def Fg : FrameOver intOrder := sorry' leaves the state carrier Fg.toTaskFrame.toFibre.1 stuck, so '(τ.state t).2' fails with 'Invalid projection' and every dotted S-constructor loses its expected type. Fix: put the frame, its IsRegular instance and the model in the unpinned preamble as abbrevs with real bodies (737 plan precedent); pin theorems only. Cost: one extra compile (~2 min).

Correction to the previous pinning entry: the all-abbrev Challenge preamble (abbrev edge/Rg/Fg/Mg, anonymous IsRegular instance, theorems only pinned) DOES compile -- the identical file (B3) passed on re-run with exit 0 and 29 sorry warnings, and bisection variants (namespace removed, docstrings stripped, double-abbrev T8) all pass. The earlier 'Invalid projection' failures were not reproducible; only the sorry-bodied 'def Fg := sorry' shape (T4) fails deterministically. Net cost: five extra ~7s compiles. The plan pins the all-abbrev preamble, which is the only shape the snapshot tool's DECL_RE leaves intact.

Root cause of the two 'non-reproducible' compile failures: lake-build-guard REPLAY. The log of the second run on challenge739.lean opens with 'lake-build-guard: REPLAY: sharing result from holder pid 3850255, age 82s, recorded exit status 1' -- the guard returned the first run's cached failure for the same file path instead of recompiling the edited file. Implementer tip: when iterating on one file path within ~2 minutes, check the log head for a REPLAY line before trusting the verdict (copy to a new path, or wait out the window).

Plan-time verification closed every carried figure cheaply: the value table was re-derived by an independent 30-line fixpoint script (8/8 rows agree with the report), the 29 pinned Lean Challenge Statements type-checked standalone in ~7s per compile, and lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --dry-run cross-validated the Goals identifier set (route plan-declared, no mismatch) and produced an assembled Challenge module that compiles with 29 sorries and no errors. Statement drift risk for the implement phase is near zero.
